prompt: How close is every part of the southern tip of Lower Manhattan to a park? Use the OpenStreetMap extract in this checkout, docs/examples/data/lower_mnt.osm.pbf, cut to the box from longitude -74.0195 to -74.0085 and latitude 40.7 to 40.7085. With Autark, load its streets, parks and water, and bin the parks into a 30 by 30 grid where each cell counts the parks within about 150 m of its center, measured to the nearest edge of each park. Draw that grid on a map over the streets, parks and water, and give me a table of the share of the area by how many parks are within reach: none, one, two to four, five to nine, and ten or more.
